chunks.l2:
[tal-a22-v01] Now the so-called liṅga-lifting we speak: solely enjoined in the Śiva-teaching.

[tal-a22-v10] And the sequence: śakti-descent, impurity-loss, departure-desire, initiation, awakening, abandonable-loss, acceptable-dissolution-nature.

[tal-a22-v02] Told in the venerable Mālinītantra, indeed: the earth-upholding — having declared, who is yoked where, he from it does not turn back.

[tal-a22-v03] Arisen from fitness, whose just where the teaching: he just there is to be appointed; at initiation-time, then, but this one.

[tal-a22-v04] Fruit, all, having attained, in Śiva: though yoked, released; though unyoked, upper purification, having attained from Bhuvaneśa.

[tal-a22-v05] Purified, he comes to Śiva-hood, burnt-saṃsāra-bonded; having declared man-upholding — and told, this Vedāntic, by me.

[tal-a22-v06] To Kapila formerly told, in the first chapter, so: by this, through sequential yoga, attained — the highest state.

[tal-a22-v07] Not again to beast-hood goes: in the pure own self he stands; hence, for, is hinted the meaning — this, even for those below the Śiva-principle.

[tal-a22-v08] In the principles, of the yoked there is re-extractability: of the giver of all-śāstra-taught thing-distinctions.

[tal-a22-v09] Of the Śiva-āgama is distinction than all — even — āgamas; and through Śiva-knowledge, without, again even beast-arising.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-:C22 atha śrītantrāloke dvāviṃśatitamamāhnikam liṅgoddhārākhyāmatha vacmaḥ śivaśāsanaikanirdiṣṭām uktaṃ śrīmālinītantre kila pārthivadhāraṇām / uktvā yo yojito yatra sa tasmānna nivartate yogyatāvaśasaṃjātā yasya yatraiva śāsanā / sa tatraiva niyoktavyo dīkṣākāle tatastvasau phalaṃ sarvaṃ samāsādya śive yukto@pavṛjyate / ayukto@pyūrdhvasaṃśuddhiṃ saṃprāpya bhuvaneśataḥ śuddhaḥ śivatvamāyāti dagdhasaṃsārabandhanaḥ / uktvā puṃdhāraṇāṃ coktametadvaidāntikaṃ mayā kapilāya purā proktaṃ prathame paṭale tathā / anena kramayogena saṃprāptaḥ paramaṃ padam na bhūyaḥ paśutāmeti śuddhe svātmani tiṣṭhati / ato hi dhvanyate@rtho@yaṃ śivatattvādhareṣvapi tattveṣu yojitasyāsti punaruddharaṇīyatā / samastaśāstrakathitavastuvaiviktyadāyinaḥ śivāgamasya sarvebhyo@pyāgamebhyo viśiṣṭatā / śivajñānena ca vinā bhūyo@pi paśutodbhavaḥ kramaśca śaktisaṃpāto malahāniryiyāsutā / dīkṣā bodho heyahānirupādeyalayātmatā

chunks.l2:
[tal-a22-v11] Enjoyable-fettered-renouncing, lord-agency-destruction, self-abiding — and thus: for one standing in another view.

[tal-a22-v12] Told is extractability of the Śiva-śakti-impelled, for: now, of those in lower systems from Vaiṣṇava and Buddhist to Tantric.

[tal-a22-v13] When by Śiva-sun-ray-floods opened is the heart-lotus, then first liṅga-extracting, afterwards the initiation-rite.

[tal-a22-v14] Even formerly other-marked, from initiation may he reach Śiva-hood: there having made fast, him, and on another day, by the common mantra.

[tal-a22-v15] On the altar, having worshipped the Lord, he should proclaim: his procedure. This one formerly was a mark-bearer, impelled, but now, by You.

[tal-a22-v16] By the gracious, then to him: make — proper favor: arisen from own-mark-abandoning-doubt, expiation, and may not his be.

[tal-a22-v17] Quickly become of Thee, enjoyment, liberation, let him attain: 'so be it' — thus the command, and having received, vow — his — that.

[tal-a22-v18] Having discarded — in water, having placed, should bathe fittingly: the bathed one, should sprinkle with argha-vessel waters — next.

[tal-a22-v19] The five cow-products, tooth-stick, then to him should offer; then him, blindfolded, and having ushered, should make bow.

[tal-a22-v20] Praṇava, mātṛkā, māyā, all-pervading, six-syllabled, many-formed — then, called Netra, seven common ones: these.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-bhogyatvapāśavatyāgaḥ patikartṛtvasaṃkṣayaḥ / svātmasthitiścetyevaṃ hi darśanāntarasaṃsthiteḥ proktamuddharaṇīyatvaṃ śivaśaktīritasya hi / atha vaiṣṇavabauddhāditantrāntādharavartinām yadā śivārkaraśmyoghairvikāsi hṛdayāmbujam / liṅgoddhṛtistadā pūrvaṃ dīkṣākarma tataḥ param prāgliṅgāntarasaṃstho@pi dīkṣātaḥ śivatāṃ vrajet / tatropavāsya taṃ cānyadine sādhāramantrataḥ sthaṇḍile pūjayitveśaṃ śrāvayettasya vartanīm / eṣa prāgabhavalliṅgī coditastvadhunā tvayā prasannena tadetasmai kuru samyaganugraham / svaliṅgatyāgaśaṅkotthaṃ prāyaścittaṃ ca māsya bhūt acirāttvanmayībhūya bhogaṃ mokṣaṃ prapadyatām / evamastvityathājñāṃ ca gṛhīrvā vratamasya tat apāsyāmbhasi nikṣipya snapayedanurūpataḥ / snātaṃ saṃprokṣayedarghapātrāmbhobhiranantaram pañcagavyaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ tatastasmai samarpayet / tatastaṃ baddhanetraṃ ca praveśya praṇipātayet praṇavo mātṛkā māyā vyomavyāpī ṣaḍakṣaraḥ / bahurūpo@tha netrākhyaḥ sapta sādhāraṇā amī

chunks.l2:
[tal-a22-v21] Of them, from the middle, one mantra to him should bestow: he too, day and night, indeed it, should mutter, little-eating, fasting.

[tal-a22-v22] Mantra to him, having bestowed, then, in the rite-purified fire, libated that mantra, vow-purity he should perform.

[tal-a22-v23] With the worshipped alone, mantra, having made name — his, enclosure: expiation, 'I cleanse' — through phaṭ-svāhā-ūha practice.

[tal-a22-v24] A hundred, a thousand, or, having offered, again the full oblation, likewise, through use vauṣaḍ-ending, and having cast, having invoked Vrateśvara.

[tal-a22-v25] 'Tāra, to Vrateśvara' — quoted; 'homage!' — and him should worship: and should proclaim, by you, not his to be done, anything by Śiva's command.

[tal-a22-v26] Then Vrateśvara to be libated, with svāhā-ending: and then he, having asked pardon, to be dismissed, should be; then of fire too, dismissal.

[tal-a22-v27] That proclamation, and, to the god: 'forgive!' — quoted, is dismissal; then on the third day, as before, all the rite is remembered.

[tal-a22-v28] Eve-rite-and-the-rest, ending in own-desired-initiation-rite: of the former mark-bearers, liberation-initiation, devoid of qualification.

[tal-a22-v29] On the adept-teacher path, not fit are they, the reborn ones; even of the reborn, kindled by knowledge, they become the abode of guruhood.

[tal-a22-v30] For liberation alone, not for enjoyment; for enjoyment too, through means: thus said in his own Paddhati — Īśānaśiva the teacher.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-teṣāṃ madhyādekatamaṃ mantramasmai samarpayet / so@pyahorātramevainaṃ japedalpabhugapyabhuk mantramasmai samarpyātha sādhāravidhisaṃskṛte / vahnau tarpitatanmantre vrataśuddhiṃ samācaret pūjitenaiva mantreṇa kṛtvā nāmāsya saṃpuṭam / prāyaścittaṃ śodhayāmi phaṭsvāhetyūhayogataḥ śataṃ sahasraṃ vā hutvā punaḥ pūrṇāhutiṃ tathā / prayogādvauṣaḍantāṃ ca kṣiptvāhūya vrateśvaram tāro vrateśvarāyeti namaścetyenamarcayet / śrāvayecca tvayā nāsya kāryaṃ kiṃcicchivājñayā tato vrateśvarastarpyaḥ svāhāntena tataśca saḥ / kṣamayitvā visṛjyaḥ syāttato@gneśca visarjanam tacchrāvaṇaṃ ca devāya kṣamasveti visarjanam / tatastṛtīyadivase prāgvatsarvo vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ adhivāsādikaḥ sveṣṭadīkṣākarmāvasānakaḥ / prāgliṅgināṃ mokṣadīkṣā sādhikāravivarjitā sādhakācāryatāmārge na yogyāste punarbhuvaḥ / punarbhuvo@pi jñāneddhā bhavanti gurutāspadam mokṣāyaiva na bhogāya bhogāyāpyabhyupāyataḥ / ityuktavānsvapaddhatyāmīśānaśivadaiśikaḥ

chunks.l2:
[tal-a22-v31] Of the venerable Devī, rightly proclaiming the truth of the Yāmalī saying, of the guru, even of one sunk in downward gaze: this rite — perform.

[tal-a22-v32] Having performed, the secret one should tell, not otherwise, in the Kāmika, indeed: though initiated in another tantra, the secret not disclose.

[tal-a22-v33] Standing free, yet having approached an ignorant guru, being unassured there after: there too, the rite he should perform.

[tal-a22-v34] Come through an ignorant teacher's mouth, powerless — mantra, this: which muttered, he as guru — even here: not from authority-told defect.

[tal-a22-v35] Then his purity, first having made, then initiation he should perform: by one established in a lower view, formerly initiated.

[tal-a22-v36] Through intense śakti, afterwards, when he should approach the true guru: then too, his, of the child indeed, purity having made, the true guru.

[tal-a22-v37] Initiation-and-the-rest rite, entire, should do as toldly enjoined: attained even, the true guru, fitness-state of his, not knows, if.

[tal-a22-v38] In knowledge-giving, that, the disciple, fitness, should show his own: in every way, but non-speaking, this one; speaking, or contrary.

[tal-a22-v39] Ignorant, in reality, just: having abandoned that, so the rite he should perform; not concealment-doubt here is to be made, by the intelligent.

[tal-a22-v40] Lower-touching: concealment, not higher-means-discernment, in the Siddhānta, initiated in the tantra of ten-and-eight-division.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-śrīdevyā yāmalīyoktitattvasamyakpravedakaḥ / gurvantasyāpyadhodṛṣṭiśāyinaḥ saṃskriyāmimām kṛtvā rahasyaṃ kathayennānyathā kāmike kila / anyatantrābhiṣikte@pi rahasyaṃ na prakāśayet svatantrastho@pi gurvanto gurumajñamupāśritaḥ / tatra paścādanāśvastastatrāpi vidhimācaret ajñācāryamukhāyātaṃ nirvīryaṃ mantrameṣa yat / japtavānsa guruścātra nādhikāryuktadūṣaṇāt tato@sya śuddhiṃ prākkṛtvā tato dīkṣāṃ samācaret / adhodarśanasaṃsthena guruṇā dīkṣitaḥ purā tīvraśaktivaśātpaścādyadā gacchetsa sadgurum / tadāpyasya śiśorevaṃ śuddhiṃ kṛtvā sa sadguruḥ dīkṣādikarma nikhilaṃ kuryāduktavidhānataḥ / prāpto@pi sadgururyogyabhāvamasya na vetti cet vijñānadāne tacchiṣyo yogyatāṃ darśayennijām / sarvathā tvabruvanneṣa bruvāṇo vā viparyayam ajño vastuta eveti tattyaktvetthaṃ vidhiṃ caret / na tirobhāvaśaṅkātra kartavyā buddhiśālinā adhaḥspṛktvaṃ tirobhūtirnordhvopāyavivecanam / siddhānte dīkṣitāstantre daśāṣṭādaśabhedini

chunks.l2:
[tal-a22-v41] In the Bhairavīya sixty-four: those beasts should be initiated into Trika; in the Siddhavīrāvalī-essence, in the Bhairavīya, in the Kula too.

[tal-a22-v42] Taken up through the five-initiation-sequence, initiation called highest, hence everyone low-placed, even, by liṅga-lifting is graced.

[tal-a22-v43] Whoever, from heart-dwelling-Maheśāna impulsion, vast scripture-knowledge should seek, he too, should go to many gurus.

[tal-a22-v44] Their initiations also, should take, with-consecration-not-last: knowledge-strengthened, they, for by those knowing ones performed.

[tal-a22-v45] Told, and, in the venerable scripture, there, there, and, muchly, delight-seeking, as the bee roams from flower to flower.

[tal-a22-v46] Knowledge-seeking, so the disciple, from the guru: to another guru, quoted: among many gurus, for whence knowledge is highest.

[tal-a22-v47] Attained, he, his guru; initiation, not here, is primary, for in consciousness, the all-knowledge-treasure: but having reached the guru, well-established.

[tal-a22-v48] Him alone may the wise worship, eager with that inquiry into that: thus the initiation-rule, told, liṅga-lifting-crowned.
chunks.sanskrit: [and]-bhairavīye catuḥṣaṣṭau tānpaśūndīkṣayettrike / siddhavīrāvalīsāre bhairavīye kule@pi ca pañcadīkṣākramopāttā dīkṣānuttarasaṃjñitā / tena sarvo@dharastho@pi liṅgoddhṛtyānugṛhyate yo@pi hṛtsthamaheśānacodanātaḥ suvistṛtam / śāstrajñānaṃ samanvicchetso@pi yāyādbahūngurūn taddīkṣāścāpi gṛhṇīyādabhiṣecanapaścimāḥ / jñānopodbalikāstā hi tattajjñānavatā kṛtāḥ uktaṃ ca śrīmate śāstre tatra tatra ca bhūyasā / āmodārthī yathā bhṛṅgaḥ puṣpātpuṣpāntaraṃ vrajet vijñānārthī tathā śiṣyo gurorgurvantaraṃ tviti / gurūṇāṃ bhūyasāṃ madhye yato vijñānamuttamam prāptaṃ so@sya gururdīkṣā nātra mukhyā hi saṃvidi / sarvajñānanidhānaṃ tu guruṃ saṃprāpya susthitaḥ tamevārādhayeddhīmāṃstattajjijñāsanonmukhaḥ / iti dīkṣāvidhiḥ prokto liṅgoddharaṇapaścimaḥ
